primary_changed_factor: same trained candidate-utility head architecture and inference path as LFM_V7_S_FINAL (1,511,425 params, 129 legal windows, win/out token-mean pooling + position, 2305-d, MLP+2-layer eager self-attention, per-frame max-window centre, B0 EMA .25 path, all-select mask, YuNet fallback). The HEAD is retrained on a multi-geometry pool: RetargetVid native crops + 90-degree rotated crops (1:3 <-> 3:1, covering portrait-source geometry) + LIVE-YT-VC real 1920x1080->9:16 vertical-window sources (1115 train sources). Selection on rv_dev + rv_rot_dev + live_dev; confirmed on rv_diag (incl. rotated) and live_confirmation (227 sources never used for training or selection). Source-level paired bootstrap vs the V7-recipe arm on live_confirmation: +0.0271 [+0.0182,+0.0365], 151 wins / 75 losses.

fixed_conditions.path: B0 EMA alpha .25 on free axis, B0 thumbnail-diff resets, hold within shot
fixed_conditions.fallback: B0 observation on head failure / before first keyframe

training.data: RetargetVid 6-annotator mean crop IoU (native + 90-deg rotated augmentation) + LIVE-YT-VC frozen spatial_crop_v1 window GT; no teacher output, no B0 observation, no official/semifinal test data
training.splits: RV train 001-030+621-700 (110 src), LIVE train 1115 src / live_dev 124 src (selection) / live_confirmation 227 src (confirmation, fresh for this head)
training.device_note: trained on CPU (NPU driver unavailable 2026-09-30/10-01); head is fp32 torch, inference on NPU fp16 vision tower

notes: Semifinal (426-video) run. No official score is predicted or claimed; arm selection used only held-out proxy pools.
